note: Saved cost in seconds of each case of a sharded suite, by suite name and case name, taken from the case timings of the last gate or hosted run. scripts/quality/case_shards.py packs the cases of a suite into its shards by these costs, heaviest first, each case into the lightest shard. A case without a cost is packed with the median cost, and a suite without costs goes round robin in inventory order. A cost changes only the balance, never which cases run. The costs of run_checks_e2e are the seconds of the cases rows in the shard manifests (manifest.json) of the validation run of Nov 14 2026 on the combined tree (four shards at once, 803 units).
